claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures the satellite accumulation quantity limits, location condition, operational control prerequisite, and broad regulatory exemptions established in paragraph (A).

Claim C0001 correctly extracts the alternative compliance pathway permitting adherence to satellite accumulation exemption rules instead of central accumulation conditions, preserving the explicit exceptions in (A)(7) and (A)(8).

Claim C0002 accurately records the mandatory corrective actions required when a satellite container is in poor condition or leaking, including the immediate timing and both authorized destination alternatives.
Claim C0003 preserves the standard requiring containers to be made of or lined with compatible materials to ensure containment is not impaired.
Claim C0004 faithfully reflects the prohibition against co-locating incompatible wastes or materials in the same container unless compliance with rule 3745-65-17(B) is achieved.
Claim C0005 correctly retains the prohibition on placing hazardous waste into an unwashed container that previously held incompatible waste or material without meeting rule 3745-65-17(B).
Claim C0006 accurately states the duty to isolate or protect containers holding hazardous waste from incompatible materials accumulated nearby.

Claim C0007 faithfully represents the requirement to keep satellite containers closed at all times, together with all statutory exceptions for adding, removing, or consolidating waste, and temporary venting for equipment operation or hazard prevention.

In F013:F015, paragraphs (A)(5)(a) and (A)(5)(b) are joined by the conjunction 'and', making both the words 'Hazardous Waste' and an indication of hazards conjunctive requirements. Claim C0008 changes this into a disjunctive choice ('either ... or'), erroneously allowing compliance by providing only one marking.

Paragraphs (A)(6)(a) and (A)(6)(b) mandate action within 'three consecutive calendar days'. Claim C0009 erroneously alters this critical threshold to 'thirty consecutive calendar days' in both summary and choice text.

Claim C0010 accurately preserves the continuing compliance duties and the requirement to label containers with the accumulation start date during the three-consecutive-calendar-day excess accumulation period.
Claim C0011 accurately captures small quantity generator preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure duties for satellite accumulation areas.
Claim C0012 accurately captures large quantity generator preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure duties for satellite accumulation areas.
Claim C0013 correctly conveys the administrative reference note directing readers to rule 3745-50-11 for publication dates of incorporated materials.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 fully and accurately retains the satellite accumulation quantity limits, location criteria, operator control, and permit exemption qualifications.
Claim C0001 preserves the alternative compliance option and its exceptions under paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8).
Claim C0002 covers the requirement to transfer waste immediately if the container leaks or is damaged, including both permitted destination options.
Claim C0003 fully retains the container compatibility requirement.
Claim C0004 fully retains the prohibition against mixing incompatible wastes or materials in the same container.
Claim C0005 covers the prohibition on placing hazardous waste in unwashed containers previously holding incompatible materials.
Claim C0006 covers the requirement to isolate or protect containers from nearby incompatible materials.
Claim C0007 retains the main obligation to keep satellite accumulation containers closed at all times during accumulation.
Claim C0007 explicitly incorporates the exception permitting containers to be opened when adding, removing, or consolidating waste.
Claim C0007 explicitly incorporates the temporary venting exception for equipment operation.
Claim C0007 explicitly incorporates the temporary venting exception to prevent dangerous pressure build-up.
Claim C0008 misconstrues the cumulative labeling requirement as an 'either/or' choice, wrongly suggesting that marking 'Hazardous Waste' is optional if hazard indications are provided.
Claim C0008 presents hazard indication labeling as an alternative rather than a mandatory co-requirement alongside 'Hazardous Waste' marking.
Claim C0009 misstates the required compliance deadline as thirty consecutive calendar days instead of three consecutive calendar days.
Claim C0009 distorts the removal timeline to thirty consecutive calendar days rather than three consecutive calendar days.
Claim C0009 distorts the removal timeline to an on-site permitted facility to thirty consecutive calendar days rather than three consecutive calendar days.
Claim C0009 distorts the removal timeline to an off-site designated facility to thirty consecutive calendar days rather than three consecutive calendar days.
Claim C0010 covers the interim compliance requirements and excess accumulation start date labeling during the three-day period.
Claim C0011 fully captures the preparedness, prevention, and emergency requirements for small quantity generators.
Claim C0012 fully captures the preparedness, prevention, and emergency requirements for large quantity generators.
Claim C0013 fully conveys the incorporated by reference explanatory comment.
